title: Phase 134 publishes mission decision register
summary: Give each priority mission a complete decision packet while keeping every answer unadjudicated until owner review.
evidence_note: AI-assisted source triage can map exact artifacts and expose their limits, but it cannot stand in for the repository's required human admissibility decision.
publication_effect: Adds or updates 7 public HTML route(s), their canonical integration, and one schema-1.0 JSON export.
